items.question: What syllable counts and prefixed bījas define this mantra form?
premises: The mantra is described as eighteen-syllabled.
The mantra is preceded by the bīja syllables hrīṃ and śrīṃ.
With these prefixed bījas the mantra becomes twenty-syllabled.
items.inference: Adding the two bīja syllables hrīṃ and śrīṃ to the eighteen-syllabled mantra yields a twenty-syllabled form.
items.plain_english: This mantra is eighteen-syllabled; when preceded by hrīṃ and śrīṃ, it becomes twenty-syllabled.
